description: Source-qualified, purpose-specific complete findings over exact artifacts and selected certificate, key or material identities. Explicit case period dates earliest complete finding in the named preserved history. No local extraction, cryptographic verification, trust, ownership, signing-time, novelty outside the declared collection, or accepted assessment is supplied.

period.description: Explicit analyst/case-selected complete-finding interval; no inherited duration.

history.description: Exact source-backed collection-scoped complete finding history.

role.description: Actual signature/material role; never inferred from container presence.

certificate_selector.description: Selected typed certificate/key/issuer tuple, no fallback.

exclude_selected_credentials.description: Explicit applicable credential-class exclusion; default retain.

classification_class.description: Exact source classification name selected by this policy; different classes are not contradictory assertions.

classification_records.description: Exact evidenced classification records selected for exclusion.

classification_period.description: Independent class applicability period, explicitly not assumed actual signing time.

amendment_sources.description: Explicit source scope for retained correction/withdrawal context; no claim of universal absence.

image_selector.description: Exact purpose-specific typed comparison with provenance.

material_selector.description: Exact purpose-specific typed comparison with provenance.

reference_mode.description: A typed selector alone or an explicitly evidenced artifact-derived reference.

reference_artifact.description: Exact artifact claimed by the selected source-backed reference.

finding_scope.literal: earliest complete supported claim in supplied source-declared collection history

policies.reason: Explicit selected credential classification over its own selected context period; no artifact purpose, trust or actor inference.
